items.name: SaaSHub
items.cost: Free listing route available; paid promotion optional
items.next_action: PRIORITY: submit ToolScout for durable category and comparison discovery; use a ToolScout-domain email if requested.

items.name: AlternativeTo
items.cost: Community submission; free queue may be slow
items.next_action: PRIORITY: verify ToolScout qualifies as a web service, then submit under accurate discovery/recommendation positioning. Durable alternative-search exposure makes this high value.

items.name: Peerlist Launchpad
items.cost: Free
items.next_action: PRIORITY: complete founder profile and launch ToolScout to the builder/developer audience.

items.name: MicroLaunch
items.cost: Free entry with optional premium exposure reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: PRIORITY: submit through free route; prepare short tagline, concise description, logo and screenshots. Avoid paid promotion until organic value is measured.

items.name: Fazier
items.cost: Free submission with optional promotion
items.next_action: PRIORITY: submit ToolScout to the free discovery queue; record live URL and referral traffic before considering promotion.

items.name: BetaList
items.cost: Submission available; free placement may have a long queue
items.next_action: Submit after faster high-priority targets. ToolScout is already launched, so BetaList is useful but less urgent than evergreen discovery and active launch channels.

items.name: StackShare
items.cost: Free listing reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: Validate category fit. Strong authority but developer/tech-stack orientation means submit only if ToolScout fits naturally.

items.name: SourceForge
items.cost: Free software listing reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: Validate whether ToolScout qualifies cleanly as a software product/service before vendor submission; high authority makes this worth checking.

items.name: Tiny Startups
items.cost: Free review queue plus optional paid tiers reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: Submit through the free review route first; avoid paid placement until referral quality is known.

items.name: Launching Next
items.cost: Verify current submission tier before checkout
items.next_action: Submit ToolScout as a newly launched startup/product and record the resulting listing URL.

items.name: TinyLaunch
items.cost: Free listing reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: Verify the live submission form, then submit ToolScout if no paid-only gate is introduced.

items.name: PitchWall
items.cost: Free submission reported in current 2026 research
items.next_action: Create/login and submit a concise ToolScout launch profile; record approval/live URL.

items.name: Indie Hackers
items.cost: Free account
items.next_action: Publish a useful founder/product story rather than a directory-style promotional post.

items.name: Hacker News — Show HN
items.cost: Free account
items.next_action: Use only when there is a strong builder story and a product people can try immediately; keep title factual.

items.name: DevHunt
items.cost: Free submission is reported, but audience fit needs validation
items.next_action: Validate whether ToolScout is sufficiently developer-focused before using time on submission.

items.name: Startup Stash
items.cost: Verify listing terms
items.next_action: Verify current listing route and ToolScout category fit.

items.name: G2
items.cost: Free profile; value increases materially with verified reviews
items.next_action: Defer until ToolScout has users/reviews and a clear G2 category. Revisit when review acquisition is realistic.

items.name: Capterra / G2 Digital Markets
items.cost: Free listing route; paid buyer-acquisition options exist
items.next_action: Defer until category fit and review acquisition justify signup. Account for the 2026 G2 Digital Markets ownership/integration when revisiting.

submission_pack.tagline: Find the right software for the job — without the noise.
submission_pack.short_description: ToolScout is an independent software discovery and recommendation platform that turns a buyer's workflow and intent into a focused shortlist of relevant tools, with transparent comparisons and no pay-to-rank recommendations.
submission_pack.audience: Small businesses, consultants, agencies, creators, sales and marketing teams, and software buyers.
submission_pack.differentiator: Intent-driven recommendations rather than a generic directory. Affiliate relationships never influence ranking.
